lessons.title: Practice Complement Rule
lessons.description: Implement prob_at_least_one(p_single, n) = 1 - (1-p)^n for independent trials. The test checks that prob_at_least_one(0.5, 1) equals 0.5; prob_at_least_one(0.5, 2) equals 0.75.
learning_objectives: This step subtracts the chance from one, using chance and 2.
lessons.solution_code:
def prob_at_least_one(p_single, n):
    return 1.0 - (1.0 - p_single) ** n

lessons.title: Practice Bayes Update
lessons.description: Implement bayes(prior, likelihood, evidence) = prior*likelihood/evidence. The test checks that bayes(0.01, 0.9, 0.1) equals 0.09.
learning_objectives: This step weights the prior by the likelihood, using prior and 2.
lessons.solution_code:
def bayes(prior, likelihood, evidence):
    return (prior * likelihood) / evidence

lessons.title: Practice Checkpoint Expected Value
lessons.description: Implement expected_value(values, probs) for discrete outcomes. The test checks that expected_value([1, 2, 3], [0.2, 0.5, 0.3]) equals 2.1.
learning_objectives: This step adds value times chance, using value and 2.
lessons.solution_code:
def expected_value(values, probs):
    return sum(v * p for v, p in zip(values, probs))

source.name: Dive into Deep Learning — Probability — expectation E[X] = Σ x P(X = x)
